notes: Loopback HTTP to the CLI; excludes Reader proxy, browser rendering and network/Wi-Fi latency.
Cold means fresh CLI publication cache, with OS filesystem cache uncontrolled (not a cold-disk benchmark).
Warm HTTP requests use identity encoding, persistent connections, and fully consume bodies; debug mode is enabled for memory snapshots.
Heap snapshots labelled post_gc force GC and are taken outside timed workloads. RSS/peak RSS are sampled only on Linux; peak RSS covers process lifetime.
Fixtures are synthetic unless external EPUB/audio overrides are specified. Generated WAV does not cover M4B chapter probing; CBZ repeats one PNG page.
No 2x/5x improvement is claimed by this baseline. Production cache behavior is unchanged.
